chunks: And when the sky is stripped away.

key_terms.السَّمَاءُ: The sky or heaven, often referring to the visible dome or cosmic layers.
key_terms.کُشِطَتْ: Was stripped, peeled back, or removed, implying the removal of a covering or layer.

ai.seo_question: What does it mean when the sky is 'stripped away' in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah al-Infitar is often linked to the cosmic signs preceding the appearance of the Mahdi (aj), symbolizing the stripping away of worldly illusions to reveal divine truth. The imagery of the sky being 'peeled back' reflects the transition from the hidden state (Ghaybah) to the visible reality of God's sovereignty, emphasizing the imminent restructuring of the universe.
